options.reason: The table was evidently assembled to relate physicochemical measurements (acidity, sulfur dioxide, alcohol, density, pH, sulphates) to the sensory quality grade, which has seven observed integer levels 3-9, so the natural supervised aim is multiclass prediction of quality; color is a legitimate covariate and no column is a component or recoding of the grade.
options.title: multiclass

options.reason: Because quality is an ordinal grade rather than a nominal category, an ordinal-as-numeric regression on the same physicochemical features is an equally defensible framing of the same study aim.
options.title: regression
